summary: Operator site (© 2026): confirmed $50 (30-amp) / $65 (50-amp) a night all-in, 50-amp; added water and sewer at every site, 57 sites, showers, laundry, CampLife booking. Note trimmed of rates and the Good Sam line. Long-stay tests pass (nightly rate posted, no application, no homes or lots for sale). Not stated: rig length, pull-throughs, season, Wi-Fi.
flags: Price gate: base $50/night (30-amp, 'Prices include all taxes, fees, and utilities') sits exactly at the US$50 line, not over it; no gateway within 40 km (nearest Jacksonville 354 km); the family has not stayed here.
Phone: the contact page lists (850) 778-1357 first and (914) 874-3493 second; the entry carries only the out-of-state 914 number.

Waterfront lead (minor): the operator advertises 'Two Fishing Ponds ... scenic, stocked water features located right on the property'; the entry is 'not waterfront'. Probably small ponds, but worth a look.
No Hurricane Isaias closure notice on the operator site as of 2026-10-21.
